name: Billcraft
tagline: Invoicing for freelancers and small studios
description: For freelancers and small studios who need to send proper invoices without paying for an accounting suite. It handles quotes, invoices, partial payments and client statements, and shows at a glance who owes what and how late it is.
scope: Invoices and quotes with live preview
features: Invoice editor with live paper preview, drag-to-reorder lines, per-line tax and percentage or fixed discounts
Automatic sequential numbering that never reuses the number of a sent invoice
Multiple partial payments per invoice, with overdue status computed from the due date
Quotes that convert to invoices, and duplicate for any document
Dashboard with outstanding, overdue, paid this month and an aged-receivables breakdown
Per-client statements with running balances, print stylesheet for A4 or Letter, CSV and JSON export, validated JSON import
engineering: All money runs in integer cents through BigInt rounding: a discount is split across lines by the largest remainder method, then tax is rounded once per rate, so the printed tax summary always adds up exactly.
